owner: Angelea McCullough, Founder of RMS Global Publishing
purpose: Non-destructive baseline for Discord live rooms used with OBS Studio, Elgato Wave Link, and Elgato Camera Hub.
principles: Discord remains functional if OBS, Wave Link, Camera Hub, or the RMS Discord bridge is unavailable.
Do not change global Windows audio devices solely for one Discord room.
Use dedicated monitor and stream mixes to prevent echo and double monitoring.
Do not route confidential creator audio into public rooms without explicit consent.
Record only when the room and event explicitly disclose recording status.

discord.input_device: Wave Link MicrophoneFX or the approved clean microphone mix
discord.output_device: Wave Link Game or approved monitoring mix
discord.echo_cancellation: evaluate per room; keep enabled for open-speaker sessions, disable only in controlled headphone-based studio routing if verified
discord.noise_suppression: light or disabled when Wave Link processing already provides clean gating/noise control
discord.automatic_gain_control: disable for controlled studio sessions; use only for general community voice rooms if needed
discord.attenuation: 0 percent for production rooms unless host intentionally uses ducking

wave_link.microphone_path: Mic -> Wave Link processing -> MicrophoneFX -> Discord
wave_link.stream_path: Mic + approved sources -> Stream Mix -> OBS
avoid: feeding Discord output back into Discord input
routing OBS monitoring back into the Discord microphone bus

obs.capture_strategy: Capture Discord audio, microphone, game/app audio, and music/media as discrete sources where practical.
obs.audio_monitoring: Monitor only the sources required by the host. Avoid Monitor and Output on a source that is already returned through Wave Link unless the signal path is verified.
obs.recording: Use separate audio tracks for microphone, Discord guests, and program audio when the production requires post-production flexibility.

camera_hub.camera_role: Primary host camera for OBS and approved video sessions.
camera_hub.exposure: Lock exposure and white balance for live sessions after lighting is set to prevent visible pumping.
camera_hub.resolution: Use the highest stable camera mode that matches the OBS canvas and available USB bandwidth.
camera_hub.background_apps: Avoid simultaneous camera access by multiple apps unless the camera/virtual-camera workflow explicitly supports it.

Game Room.priority: low-latency conversation and game audio balance

preflight: Confirm Discord input and output devices.
Confirm Wave Link Monitor Mix and Stream Mix are not cross-fed.
Confirm OBS meters show one clean instance of each intended source.
Confirm Camera Hub framing and exposure.
Confirm recording status and participant consent.
Run a 30-second local recording and playback check before flagship events.
